stories.headline: Warriors brace for Stephen Curry absence after he leaves game in Houston with abdominal soreness
stories.summary: Stephen Curry left Wednesday night's game in Houston with right abdominal soreness, and the Warriors are bracing to be without him for at least a few games, Nick Friedell of The Athletic writes. Coach Steve Kerr wasn't certain what caused the injury or exactly when it occurred.
stories.whyItMatters: An absence for Golden State's star guard would affect the Warriors' availability in upcoming games.
stories.rationale: Serious injury to a star player, with a reported multi-game absence.

stories.headline: Lakers beat Bucks 123-112 but Austin Reaves leaves with heel injury and Luka Doncic rolls ankle
stories.summary: Austin Reaves left the Lakers' 123-112 win over the Bucks with a heel injury after landing awkwardly on a missed dunk attempt in the third quarter. Coach JJ Redick said x-rays on the heel returned negative and ruled out an Achilles injury, adding, "No update on AR until we'll have imaging tomorrow." Luka Doncic also rolled an ankle late in the win.
stories.whyItMatters: Injury concerns for two key Lakers guards in the same game make their availability a key issue for the team.
stories.rationale: Two significant Lakers injury scares from one game, combined into a single story.

stories.headline: Rockets' Marcus Smart ejected for punching Warriors' Charles Bassey, likely facing suspension
stories.summary: Rockets guard Marcus Smart was ejected Wednesday after throwing a punch at the Warriors' Charles Bassey. The report says he will likely face a suspension after getting heated with Bassey, and Smart was called out for 'fake toughness'.
stories.whyItMatters: A likely suspension would take a Rockets guard out of games.
stories.rationale: On-court altercation with an ejection and a probable league discipline.

stories.headline: Windhorst: League expects Bucks to be found guilty in Gary Trent Jr. case
stories.summary: Brian Windhorst of ESPN said on The Hoop Collective podcast that "everybody in the league expects a guilty finding" regarding the Bucks' dealings with Gary Trent Jr. The shooting guard was signed to a four-year, $64MM contract in July.
stories.whyItMatters: A guilty finding would be a significant league ruling involving the Bucks' handling of a player contract.
stories.rationale: Consequential league-level story involving a team, attributed to an ESPN reporter.

stories.headline: Raptors blow 22-point home lead in 98-93 loss to Celtics
stories.summary: The Toronto Raptors surrendered the largest home lead in franchise history Wednesday, blowing a 22-point advantage in a 98-93 loss to the Boston Celtics at Scotiabank Arena, Yardbarker reports.
stories.whyItMatters: The collapse set a franchise record for the largest home lead lost.
stories.rationale: Notable game result with a franchise-record collapse.
